notes.title: 1.04.02 - Optimization
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

This minor update improves the overall optimization of the game and should reduce lags.
If you encounter any problems or bugs, please report them.

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Vox Populi: Australia 2025
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

The new game in the series: “[b]Vox Populi: Australia 2025[/b]”, about the Australian elections, is finally available on Steam!
It features all the new elements of Vox Populi with something unique: [u]post-apocalypse scenarios[/u].

These scenarios include a new map, new events, new traits, new laws and new mechanisms.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3539270/Vox_Populi_Australia_2025

notes.title: Galactic Laws
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

The major new update "[b]Galactic Laws[/b]" is now available.
It adds [u]referendums[/u] to sci-fi scenarios and the possibility to achieve total victory by passing certain laws.

Please report any problems or bugs. Enjoy the game!

[h1]Other news from the franchise[/h1]

The game "[b]Vox Populi: Australia 2025[/b]" will be released soon with new [u]post-apocalyptic[/u] scenarios.

If you are interested in this kind of atypical scenario, don't hesitate to take a look!

[url=store.steampowered.com/app/3539270/Vox_Populi_Australia_2025][img]https://i.ibb.co/bjq2d4Xg/Image-SF-Update.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Vox Populi: Deutschland 2025
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

The new game in the series: “[b]Vox Populi: Deutschland 2025[/b]”, about the German elections, is finally available on Steam!
It features all the new elements of Vox Populi (scenarios, deck building, referendums, science fiction...) with something unique: [u]alternate history scenarios[/u].

New cards, situations and flags place Germany in situations where history has been altered.

Please report any bugs or problems. Enjoy the game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3384880/Vox_Populi_Deutschland_2025
